Added ct-api.test.ts with the four TDD cases (port print, bad invocation refusal, empty session list, and the run-backend substitute that only passes CT_API_PORT/CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR/CT_HARVEST_BQ_TABLE/SHELL) all composed and run in process with no subprocess. summary: Added ScriptedTerminals (extends ProcessTable): openTerminal records {file,argv,cwd} and hands out a pid that is its own group, each terminal prints ScriptedTerminals.READY on a queued microtask, write appends to typed, signal(pid,0) throws ESRCH once the group's terminal ended and any other signal ends it, readTable prints one 'pid pgid lstart' /bin/ps-shaped row per live terminal plus one permanent unrelated row so the table is never fully empty. Ported 'a session can be closed and replaced and stays closed after backend restart' and added 'two_openings_fired_at_once_open_a_single_conversation' to ct-api.test.ts, both driven by a small ScriptedCheckout helper that scripts the exact seven git calls GitWorkspace.confirmForSession issues (remote get-url, show-toplevel, symbolic-ref, current branch, fetch, verify, ff-only merge) plus git worktree list --porcelain, and one new capture gh/issue-view-154 from a real `gh issue view https://github.com/mercadona/control-tower/issues/154 --json title,body,comments` run on this machine. The restart reuses one HostProcesses/ScriptedTerminals across two InProcessApi.started calls over the same CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR, per the closed decision. Two things worth flagging: (1) ScriptedTerminals.READY has no trailing newline, unlike the old real-process fixture's constant of the same role that happened to have none either by coincidence of its own content - I first gave it one and the SSE-frame JSON-escaping of that newline silently broke the substring wait, so it stays newline-free on purpose. (2) the git worktree list --porcelain script exists only because CtApi's background harvest clock runs its first sweep synchronously on every CtApi.run(), and on the simulated restart it already finds the checkout this test registered on the first open, surveying it for real; without that script the sweep throws UnscriptedRequest and the whole run exits 1 as an unhandled rejection - not something the brief named, but required for the suite to stay green. Appended 2 ledger rows (the ported case and the race case); the grep count for 'ct-api-real-process.test.ts >' is now 18 as the verification demands. npm run typecheck, the three named vitest files (26 tests) and the whole backend suite (165 files, 3442 passed, 1 skipped, no unhandled errors) are green; the new tests were also run five times each to rule out flakiness from the real (though small and unref'd) timers PtyLiveSessions uses for process-table inspection.
